parameters.name: ApplicationIds
parameters.description: A collection of internal network access application IDs for the dynamic route. You can enter a maximum of 200 internal network access application IDs. Required when ApplicationType is **Application**. Choose one of **ApplicationIds** or **TagIds**. Do not enter when **ApplicationType** is **All**.

parameters.name: ApplicationType
parameters.description:
The application type of the dynamic route. Valid values:

- **All**: All applications.

- **Application**: Application.

- **Tag**: Tag.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The dynamic route description. It is 1 to 128 characters long. It supports Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, periods (.), underscores (\_), hyphens (-), and spaces.

parameters.name: DynamicRouteType
parameters.description: The dynamic route type. Valid values: **connector**: Leased line.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The dynamic route name. It is 1 to 128 characters long. It supports Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: NextHop
parameters.description:
The next hop instance ID of the dynamic route. Source:

- For more information, see [ListConnectors](): Query Connectors in batches.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: The dynamic route priority. 1 indicates the highest priority. Valid values: 1-99.

parameters.name: RegionIds
parameters.description: A list of regions supported by SASE POP cluster access points.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The dynamic route status. Valid values:

- **Enabled**: Enabled.

- **Disabled**: Disabled.

parameters.name: TagIds
parameters.description: A collection of internal network access tag IDs for the dynamic route. You can enter a maximum of 40 internal network access tag IDs. Required when ApplicationType is **Tag**. Choose one of **ApplicationIds** or **TagIds**. Do not enter when **ApplicationType** is **All**.
